identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit 'Bay Area Creative Bac' (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 83-2011288) and the website bayareacreative.org shows the same EIN

Website describes arts education (poetry, hip hop dance, visual arts, after-school clubs, artist residencies), consistent with OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' category and a no-cost services agreement at an elementary school
Website says it serves families in Oakland among other Bay Area cities
research.notes: Neither the organization's site nor the other pages fetched mention OUSD or Franklin Elementary. ProPublica lists the IRS-registered city as Hayward, CA, while the agenda gives Oakland, CA; the website says it serves Oakland and other Bay Area cities, so no headquarters was filled in. The only contact on the site is a Director@ inbox, which was left out. No CA Secretary of State or SAM.gov record was checked because the web search budget ran out.

profile.summary: Bay Area Creative is a nonprofit arts education organization. It uses spoken word poetry, hip hop dance and visual arts to work with young people in under-served Bay Area communities. Its programs include artist visits and residencies, after-school clubs, summer camps, teacher professional development and student anthologies.
